definition: II. [ שְׁוָה ] verb Hithpa. be set, made (Pa`el שַׁוִּי make , Cappadocian Aramaic Lzb Eph. i. 67 ; compare Biblical Hebrew II. [ שָׁוָה ]); — Imperfect 3 masculine singular יִשְׁתַּוֵּה֑ Dan 3:29 , subject of thing + accusative be made into something ( K § 84, 3 ).
